acceptanceCriteria.statement: One pipeline: the ray law has ONE definition under src/ that both front-ends import. New module `src/worldengine/base/ejectaRays.js` exports `rayBrightnessOf(condition)` — the lab's law verbatim: clamp01(1 − erosion) × (condition.atmosphere ? 0 : 1) with erosion = surfaceHistory.erosion ?? surfaceHistory.erosionLevel ?? 0 — plus `RAY_COUNT = 6` and `RAY_SHARP = 8`. `labCore.deriveUniforms` calls it (the inline expression at labCore.js:785 is gone; the line rides in place). The crater driver block (craterDeck.js:116-197) reads the CONDITION directly — `uRayBrightness: scalar(rayBrightnessOf(condition), { gate: EJECTA_GATE })`, the same shape as its `rel = craterRelevanceOf(condition)` one step earlier — plus `uRayCount: RAY_COUNT`, `uRaySharp: RAY_SHARP`. `craterUniformsFrom` and its frozen `CRATERS_OFF` (craterUniforms.js:88-97) are UNCHANGED: the ray law is a pure condition function and must not inherit the crater schedule's fired/not-fired branch. The lab's state literal (world-engine-lab.html:1175-1176) takes the two constants from the import; `uRayBrightness` is NOT added to either LAB_BINDING (the apron's precedent) — `state.rayBrightness` keeps its single writer at :2042. `CRATER_DECK_UNIFORMS` (craterDeck.js:282-285) and `ROCKY_SURFACE_UNIFORMS` (rockySurface.js:360-374) gain exactly the three names; the sibling suites move ONLY on declared, annotated lines (AMENDED 2026-09-03 after verify wf_c18c70d0-801: the build needed more than the one count line and the AC text had not followed the diff): tests/driver-pack-rockysurface.test.js :1097 (count 23 → 26), :357 and :424 (the gated-driver set is now three names sharing the apron's gate); tests/driver-pack-craterdeck.test.js :269/:271/:276 (GAME_NAME has no counterpart key for a condition-read driver); tests/driver-pack-stormdeck.test.js :63/:156/:169 and tests/material-parity-list.test.js :539/:583 (the three names in that ledger's 'written but constant' residue).
